Folks — forwarding ClarityX's list and ask. TL;DR: +3 projects, staggered 6-week rollout, anticipate ~40% token increase in Q4. Jordan will add expected peak QPS soon.

Rishi: can you confirm pricing for a short-term commit bump vs pay-as-you-go and any standard credit we can offer for intro months? We may want to propose a small step-up (monthly reserved capacity) for predictable latency.

Marissa: can you draft a staged rollout (week-by-week) and note any gating items (VPC config, API key governance, single-tenant routing)? Include the minimal SOW amendment text we need. Alex, please flag any operational constraints on provisioning timelines.

I'm aiming to get a proposal to Jordan by EOD Monday (10/4).

Thanks — Naomi
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@clarityx.com>

Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2027 11:17:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Expansion: onboarding additional squads & key provisioning

Jordan / team — quick commercial note: for a +40% delta in token consumption we usually propose a temporary 3-month reserved uplift (simple monthly commit) to keep unit costs predictable. Options:

- Option A: 3-month 40% reserved commit at 10% discount to list; includes priority burst capacity during business hours.
- Option B: No commit, standard PAYG pricing; unit cost higher and potential throttling in peak.
- Option C: Tiered commit ( 20% immediate reserved + ability to convert to annual).

If ClarityX wants an SLO/latency guarantee for the Search team, we should earmark dedicated capacity for that project (small pool). I can draft the commercial terms and a short addendum; Naomi, Marissa — please add technical gating so I include it in the SOW draft.

Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra

Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Expansion: onboarding additional squads & key provisioning

Jordan — attached is a first-pass rollout_playbook and a short SOW-draft with the minimal amendment language. Summary of the proposed plan below: 

Week 1 (Prep): collect final project owners, confirm QPS and data residency needs, exchange service account fingerprints.
Week 2 (Provision): issue project-scoped API keys to dev/test environments (3 keys).
Week 3 (Pilot): enable analytics team in staging, enable prefix caching for Search project.
Week 4 (Staggered Prod 1): enable Claims in production on limited traffic window (3x daily ramp).
Week 5 (Staggered Prod 2): enable Analytics production + run post-deployment QA.
Week 6 (Closeout): finalize metric baselines and handoff to CS.

Gating items: final QPS numbers, network allowlists (VPC egress), and confirmation of whether any projects require Private deployment (on-prem/VPC). If Private is required we need 3 weeks additional lead time.

Attachments: rollout_playbook_v1.pdf, SOW-draft-clarityx.docx

Marissa will coordinate keys provisioning with Alex after we get the final project owners. Jordan, can you confirm that the Claims team will accept a 2-week pilot window before full cutover?

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
